fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Mechanized wheeled Level I formations used wheeled APCs for efficient patrol and garrison operations on developed worlds within the Protectorate. Their lower maintenance burden compared to tracked or hover transports made them the most common mechanized infantry type in the Word of Blake Militia's order of battle. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
